DFC Heap Solver

How this works

After the OI, the game reads the OI bomb’s damage type from memory the bomb no longer owns: the spot 0x1A8 bytes into where the bomb used to be. Whatever has been loaded there by then decides the damage. When the damage-overwriter fish’s code loads just below the OI bomb’s old spot, the word there is E4AC00BC, which has the hammer bit.

Where things land in memory depends only on the order in which things appear and disappear, not on exact frames. So you describe your method as an ordered list. Anything that ends after you pull the OI bomb is out of your hands, so the page tries every order those endings could happen in.

Two places matter: the gap Volvagia’s hole platform leaves behind (it must be full enough that the OI bomb doesn’t fall into it), and the start of the main free area, where the OI bomb should land right after one bomb-sized block that despawns before the damage overwriter.

Order of events

Enter roughly when each step happens, in game updates (20 per second), from any starting point. Count the way the notes do: bombs and bombchus don’t age during bottle drops, catches or textboxes; a fish on the floor and an arrow do. Leave a box empty to skip it.
